title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
abstract: arXiv:2611.08465v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. Our objective is to maximise the cosine similarity of a supplied residual stream direction with the activations of the text generated by the MAEM. This label-free RL objective helps to scale MAEMs on diverse sources of residual stream directions. Empirically, we find the resultant metamodel produces informative exemplars: a Qwen3.6-27B MAEM inverts held-out activations better than corpus search or a natural-language autoencoder (NLA), beats corpus search (at 10M tokens) on a majority of held-out languages/domains, and activates 89% of held-out

translated_title: 通过扩展激活反演来解释残差流的任意方向
translated_abstract: 为了解释语言模型残差流中的某个方向，我们可以寻找能够强烈激活该方向的文本。但当通过扫描语料库来寻找此类文本时，结果会受到语料库内容的限制。我们开发了最大激活示例元模型，这是一类语言模型，能够将主体模型的残差流方向映射为可以强烈激活这些方向的文本示例。我们的优化目标是最大化给定的残差流方向与MAEM所生成文本的激活之间的余弦相似度。这一无标签的强化学习目标有助于在各种残差流方向来源上扩展MAEM的规模。实验表明，所得到的元模型能够产生具有信息量的示例：一个基于Qwen3.6-27B的MAEM在反演保留激活方面优于语料库搜索或自然语言自编码器（NLA），在大多数保留的语言/领域上胜过（基于1000万token的）语料库搜索，并能激活89%的保留……
tldr: 提出最大激活示例元模型（MAEM），利用无标签强化学习目标将残差流的任意方向反演为强激活该方向的文本示例，在解释效果上超越了语料库搜索和自然语言自编码器。
en_tdlr: Proposes Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), which use a label-free RL objective to invert any residual stream direction into strongly activating text exemplars, outperforming corpus search and natural-language autoencoders for direction interpretation.
